text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I feel like I have been
achieving quite favorable results.
choice_data_list: You're getting used to racing, huh.
You're getting used to racing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's thanks to gaining experience
by running in many races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Next year is also the year I can challenge the Classics, after all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a stayer, I definitely want to secure victories
in the Kikuka Sho and its trial race, the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes! In order to achieve results in the Classics, I shall stay vigilant and maintain peak condition!
